caption: The drawing shows a rectangular section of woven material with a repeating geometric pattern of diamond shapes. Each diamond contains smaller patterns made with intersecting horizontal and vertical lines resembling a basket weave, predominantly in shades of white, light grey, and beige. The diamonds are outlined in light beige and filled with lighter tones, creating a consistent, grid-like appearance. The background outside the rectangle is a plain, light tan color. There is printed and handwritten text at the bottom of the drawing: "Westchester County" on the left, "Scale Twice Actual Size" in the center, and "drawn by I.D. Sérange" on the right. There are minor brownish stains scattered across the background.
title: Tablecloth
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
